APPTECH Italy Prototype Wheels for Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA / GTAm

Transform the appearance and performance of your Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio with exclusive APPTECH Italy GTA / GTAm Prototype Wheels. Inspired by the iconic factory Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA and GTAm, these 20-inch wheels combine aggressive motorsport styling with a precise fitment engineered specifically for the Giulia platform.

Featuring a staggered setup with wider rear wheels, these prototype wheels provide a more planted stance, improved traction, and the unmistakable appearance of Alfa Romeo's most exclusive performance models. Whether you're building a street car, weekend track machine, or show vehicle, APPTECH Italy wheels deliver the perfect balance of style, performance, and exclusivity.

Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA / GTAm Hub Bearing with Toolhead.
This complete hub bearing kit is engineered for accurate fitment on the Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA and GTAm. The central lock nut system uses different thread directions for each side of the vehicle: left-hand thread on one side and right-hand thread on the opposite side. This design ensures correct securing of the hub under high load conditions. The kit also includes a star locking plate to secure the central lock nut and a protective center cap cover. Manufactured to OEM tolerances to ensure proper alignment, long-term durability, and reliable torque distribution during street and track use.

Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA / GTAm Exhaust System. Scans only include the visible parts of the exhaust system, such as the muffler and tailpipes. The internal components of the exhaust system, such as the catalytic converter and resonator, are not included in the scans due to their location and complexity.
